periods.summary: Moroboshi hosts Ikki's victory party at his family restaurant and cooks for the guests with Koume. He later talks privately with Toka about her anti-Hahakiboshi technique and the match they never got to have. Inspired by Koume's recovered voice and aware that his body techniques still lag behind Ikki, he decides not to enter Japan's domestic league after graduation. Instead, he plans to challenge China's brutal Toushin League to find the death-edge experience needed to grow, with the eventual aim of reaching the A-League.

key_events.summary: Hosts the party and declares his plan to challenge the Toushin League.
